question: Show the top five customers by completed revenue

trace.sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS completed_revenue
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    completed_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

    c.customer_id,
